NONE: › a tree with leaves divided into five parts and seeds that turn around slowly to the ground when they fall
› (of a person or of behaviour) praising people in authority in a way that is not sincere, usually in order to get some advantage from them

example: There was sycophantic laughter from the audience at every one of his terrible jokes.
他每講一個非常糟糕的笑話，聽眾都發出諂媚的笑聲。
